title: Personal Checking: which tiers convert automatically by age
content:
## Scope

This card lists, for each Personal Checking tier, the age in whole years at which an account of the tier is converted automatically at the next statement cycle close, and the official tier name the account converts into at that age.

## Automatic conversion by tier

| Tier | Automatic conversion age (whole years) | Converts into |
|---|---|---|
| Access Checking | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| Student Checking | 25 | Everyday Checking |
| Everyday Checking | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| Interest Checking | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| Premier Checking | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| Private Client Checking | Not applicable | Not applicable |

"Not applicable" means the tier has no automatic conversion by age.

## Basis Q&A

**Q: Which Personal Checking tier is converted automatically when the owner reaches a certain age?**
A: Only Student Checking. At age 25 the account is converted into Everyday Checking.

**Q: Does an Interest Checking or Premier Checking account ever change tier because of the owner's age?**
A: No. Both show "Not applicable" for the conversion age and the conversion target.

**Hypothetical illustration**: a Student Checking owner turns 25 part-way through a statement cycle. The table places the conversion at age 25 into Everyday Checking, and the conversion is made at the statement cycle close that follows.
